title: explore_entry_filter
description: Score a learned migrate entry filter (tools/exploration_entry_model_b3.py) over one of the three frozen settings, one exit (tools/exploration_exits.py), on exploration-pool data only. See docs/contracts/job-templates.md.

trigger.description: Entry trigger event. Only the pump.fun bonding-curve migration trigger is supported.

model.description: Learned entry-filter setting (tools/exploration_entry_model_b3.py SETTINGS_B3): s1_reg is LightGBM regression on per-trade pressure-model net %; s2_clf is a LightGBM classifier on P(pressure net > 0), the EXP-011 pre-registered setting; s3_reg_winsor is regression with labels winsorized at the training fold's own 1st/99th percentile.

select_top_pct.description: Take the top N percent of migrations by model score. Mutually exclusive with threshold -- set exactly one.

threshold.description: Take migrations whose model score clears this absolute cut (0..1). Mutually exclusive with select_top_pct -- set exactly one.

exit.description: Exit rule id, one of the 41 cells tools/exploration_exits.py's build_specs() produces (tp/sl grid, trailing stop, time cap on tp50/sl30, partial-take ladder).

size_sol.description: Position size in SOL per entry. The frozen migrate-direct execution this template scores today is 0.5 SOL.

priority_fee_tier.description: Priority-fee tier for slot+1 landing. The frozen execution uses the p75 tier (0.0005 SOL/side, ARTIFACTS/lab/fee-audit-2026-09-27.md); p50/p90 are declared for future runners, not wired yet.

mcap_band.description: Optional market-cap band filter in USD. Omit or set null for no band filter.

min.description: Minimum market cap in USD, inclusive.

max.description: Maximum market cap in USD, exclusive.

days.description: Exploration-pool UTC days to read (docs/HOLDOUT_LEDGER.md), or "all" for the full 9-day exploration pool tools/exploration_entry_model_b3.py already uses (2026-09-19 through 2026-09-27).
